tone_statements.citation: Motingea Mangulu. 1990. Esquisse de la langue Motembo. In: Parlers riverains de l'entre Ubangi-Zaire: elements de structure grammaticale (Etudes Aequatoria 8), pp. 201-220. Bamanya: Centre Aequatoria. [https://www.aequatoria.be/publications/assets/Etudes_Aequatoria_8_parlers_riverains.pdf]
tone_statements.quote: Existent deux tons de base (bas et haut), avec possibilités d'obtenir des tons doubles (descendant et montant). Comparativement à la tonologie du "type lingála", on ne peut retenir qu'une légère différence : le ton bas de la première syllabe des thèmes nominaux est réalisé descendant bref lorsque la syllabe suivante est également basse; c.à.d. là où en lingála on s'attendrait à BB motémbó donne DB.
tone_statements.translation: There are two basic tones (low and high), with the possibility of double tones (falling and rising). Compared with 'Lingala-type' tonology only one slight difference can be retained: the low tone of the first syllable of noun stems is realised as a short fall when the following syllable is also low; i.e. where Lingala would have LL, Motembo gives Falling-L.
tone_statements.locator: p. 203, chapter 'Esquisse de la langue Motémbó', I. Phonologie, 6° Tonologie

sources.note: Tone typology only (riverains of Ubangi/Congo/Ngiri/Mongala have 'type lingala' tonology; word tonology not influenced by neighbouring words). Motembo not named; no accent/stress statement.

tone.translation: There are two basic tones (low and high), with the possibility of double tones (falling and rising). Compared with 'Lingala-type' tonology only one slight difference can be retained: the low tone of the first syllable of noun stems is realised as a short fall when the following syllable is also low; i.e. where Lingala would have LL, Motembo gives Falling-L.
tone.says: Motembo has two basic tones (L, H) with double (falling, rising) tones possible; tonology is of the 'Lingala type' except that a stem-initial L before another L is realised as a short fall (Lingala LL = Motembo FL); comparative Lingala/Motembo noun list with tone marks.
